grammar.explanation: 首先确认时间，然后报名 sets an order, not a claim that either step is finished. 其次 may introduce the next reason in an explanation; it is not automatically later in clock time.

examples.zh: 首先确认时间，然后报名。
examples.py: shǒu xiān què rèn shí jiān , rán hòu bào míng .
examples.en: First confirm the time, then sign up.

examples.py: shǒu xiān tīng wèn tí , rán hòu huí dá .
examples.en: First hear the question, then answer.

examples.zh: 首先看来源，然后核对日期。
examples.py: shǒu xiān kàn lái yuán , rán hòu hé duì rì qī .
examples.en: First check the source, then the date.

commonMistakes.wrong: 首先确认，然后报名，所以已经报名了。
commonMistakes.right: 这是顺序安排，还没说明报名完成。
commonMistakes.why: A planned sequence is not a completion report.

grammar.explanation: 并且 adds a related action or quality to the preceding clause. 她核对时间，并且问了地点 states two actions; it does not imply causation. Avoid using 并且 where the intended relation is a contradiction.

examples.zh: 她核对时间，并且问了地点。
examples.py: tā hé duì shí jiān , bìng qiě wèn le dì diǎn .
examples.en: She checks the time and also asks the location.

examples.zh: 活动有讲解，并且有练习。
examples.py: huó dòng yǒu jiǎng jiě , bìng qiě yǒu liàn xí .
examples.en: The activity includes explanation and practice.

examples.py: xiān tīng wán , bìng qiě jì xià wèn tí .
examples.en: Hear everything first and also note questions.

commonMistakes.why: Use a contrastive connection for opposing information.

lines.zh: 你不是一直想创业吗？现在有想法了？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì yì zhí xiǎng chuàng yè ma ? xiàn zài yǒu xiǎng fǎ le ?
lines.en: Haven't you always wanted to start a business? Do you have an idea now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有。我想开一家小书店，周末开展读书活动。
lines.py: yǒu . wǒ xiǎng kāi yī jiā xiǎo shū diàn , zhōu mò kāi zhǎn dú shū huó dòng .
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to open a small bookshop and hold reading events at weekends.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 光卖书，生意会不会不太好？
lines.py: guāng mài shū , shēng yì huì bù huì bù tài hǎo ?
lines.en: Would business be slow if you only sold books?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以我也想卖咖啡，并且留几张桌子给大家聊天。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ yě xiǎng mài kā fēi , bìng qiě liú jǐ zhāng zhuō zi gěi dà jiā liáo tiān .
lines.en: That's why I'd also sell coffee and leave a few tables for people to chat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那首先得找地方吧？
lines.py: nà shǒu xiān děi zhǎo dì fāng ba ?
lines.en: Then finding a space comes first, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，其次才是买书。我还没找到合适的店。
lines.py: duì , qí cì cái shì mǎi shū . wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào hé shì de diàn .
lines.en: Right, and buying books comes next. I haven't found a suitable place yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 学校旁边有一家店关了。要不明天一起去看看？
lines.py: xué xiào páng biān yǒu yī jiā diàn guān le . yào bù míng tiān yì qǐ qù kàn kàn ?
lines.en: A shop near the school has closed. Shall we go and look tomorrow?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。你有朋友从事这种工作吗？我想听听他们的意见。
lines.py: hǎo . nǐ yǒu péng you cóng shì zhè zhǒng gōng zuò ma ? wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng tā men de yì jiàn .
lines.en: Sure. Do you know anyone who works in this field? I'd like their advice.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有，我姐姐经营一家小店。我今晚问问她。
lines.py: yǒu , wǒ jiě jie jīng yíng yī jiā xiǎo diàn . wǒ jīn wǎn wèn wèn tā .
lines.en: Yes, my sister runs a small shop. I'll ask her tonight.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 太好了！先请她喝杯咖啡，我的问题可能有点多。
lines.py: tài hǎo le ! xiān qǐng tā hē bēi kā fēi , wǒ de wèn tí kě néng yǒu diǎn duō .
lines.en: Great! I'll buy her a coffee first. I may have quite a few questions.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A bookshop with coffee and reading events

reading.title: Plan and conditions
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 去年，我和朋友在学校附近开了一家书店。我们都没有经营经验，最初只想到书和咖啡。
lines.py: qù nián , wǒ hé péng you zài xué xiào fù jìn kāi le yī jiā shū diàn . wǒ men dōu méi yǒu jīng yíng jīng yàn , zuì chū zhǐ xiǎng dào shū hé kā fēi .
lines.en: Last year a friend and I opened a bookshop near the school. Neither of us had experience running a business; initially we only thought about books and coffee.

lines.zh: 看了几个地方以后，我们发现每个月的钱比想象的多。首先要交房租，其次要买材料，还得给职工发工资。
lines.py: kàn le jǐ gè dì fāng yǐ hòu , wǒ men fā xiàn měi gè yuè de qián bǐ xiǎng xiàng de duō . shǒu xiān yào jiāo fáng zū , qí cì yào mǎi cái liào , hái děi gěi zhí gōng fā gōng zī .
lines.en: After looking at a few spaces, we found the monthly costs were higher than expected: rent first, then supplies, and wages for staff.

lines.zh: 朋友的姐姐从事餐饮工作。她把我们的计划展开在桌上，一项一项地问。我们回答不上来，就一起去了解。
lines.py: péng you de jiě jie cóng shì cān yǐn gōng zuò . tā bǎ wǒ men de jì huà zhǎn kāi zài zhuō shàng , yī xiàng yī xiàng de wèn . wǒ men huí dá bù shàng lái , jiù yì qǐ qù liǎo jiě .
lines.en: My friend's sister works in catering. She spread our plan on the table and went through it item by item. When we couldn't answer, we went to find out together.

lines.zh: 小店开门后，生意并不是每天都好。有时一下午只卖出两本书，但读书活动慢慢有了固定的朋友。
lines.py: xiǎo diàn kāi mén hòu , shēng yì bìng bù shì měi tiān dōu hǎo . yǒu shí yī xià wǔ zhǐ mài chū liǎng běn shū , dàn dú shū huó dòng màn màn yǒu le gù dìng de péng you .
lines.en: After we opened, business wasn't good every day. Sometimes we sold only two books all afternoon, but our reading events slowly attracted a regular group.

lines.zh: 我们没有急着扩大店面，而是先建立自己的读书小组，每周开展一次活动，并且听大家想读什么。
lines.py: wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe kuò dà diàn miàn , ér shì xiān jiàn lì zì jǐ de dú shū xiǎo zǔ , měi zhōu kāi zhǎn yī cì huó dòng , bìng qiě tīng dà jiā xiǎng dú shén me .
lines.en: Instead of rushing to expand, we set up our own reading group, met weekly and listened to what people wanted to read.

lines.zh: 现在我仍然喜欢这份事业。不过，喜欢书和经营书店是两回事，后者每天都有很多小事要做。
lines.py: xiàn zài wǒ réng rán xǐ huān zhè fèn shì yè . bù guò , xǐ huān shū hé jīng yíng shū diàn shì liǎng huí shì , hòu zhě měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō xiǎo shì yào zuò .
lines.en: I still love this work. But loving books and running a bookshop are different things: the latter comes with lots of small daily tasks.

choices: Running a bookshop involves more than liking books
Reading groups always bring immediate profit
questions.answer: Running a bookshop involves more than liking books

choices: Discussed the plan item by item
questions.answer: Discussed the plan item by item

choices: They chose to develop a regular reading group first

lines.zh: 这张桌子也算我们的事业吗？
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi yě suàn wǒ men de shì yè ma ?
lines.en: Does this table count as part of our business too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 算啊。先别笑，帮我把它搬过去。
lines.py: suàn a . xiān bié xiào , bāng wǒ bǎ tā bān guò qù .
lines.en: Of course. Stop laughing and help me move it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不是说今天只看地方，不干活吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān zhǐ kàn dì fāng , bù gàn huó ma ?
lines.en: Didn't you say we were only looking at spaces today, not working?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，可老板明天要清空这里。我怕来晚了桌子就没了。
lines.py: shì , kě lǎo bǎn míng tiān yào qīng kōng zhè lǐ . wǒ pà lái wǎn le zhuō zi jiù méi le .
lines.en: Yes, but the owner is clearing this place tomorrow. I'm worried the table will be gone if we come late.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好吧。首先搬桌子，其次请我吃饭。
lines.py: hǎo ba . shǒu xiān bān zhuō zi , qí cì qǐng wǒ chī fàn .
lines.en: Fine. First we move the table, then you buy me dinner.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没问题。并且我会记住你今天帮了我。
lines.py: méi wèn tí . bìng qiě wǒ huì jì zhù nǐ jīn tiān bāng le wǒ .
lines.en: Deal. And I'll remember that you helped me today.
lines.speaker: b

The table is already at home

lines.py: hǎo ba . shǒu xiān bān zhuō zi , qí cì qǐng wǒ chī fàn .
lines.en: Fine. First we move the table, then you buy me dinner.
lines.speaker: a

extraReadings.title: More situations for these words
extraReadings.blurb: Independent everyday examples; these are separate situations.
extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 首先买票，然后找座位。
lines.py: shǒu xiān mǎi piào , rán hòu zhǎo zuò wèi .
lines.en: First buy a ticket, then find a seat.

lines.zh: 我喜欢这家店，首先是因为近，其次是因为安静。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhè jiā diàn , shǒu xiān shì yīn wèi jìn , qí cì shì yīn wèi ān jìng .
lines.en: I like this place first because it is nearby, and secondly because it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我们准备开展一次旧书交换活动。
lines.py: wǒ men zhǔn bèi kāi zhǎn yī cì jiù shū jiāo huàn huó dòng .
lines.en: We're planning a second-hand book exchange.

lines.zh: 她展开地图，指了指北边的小路。
lines.py: tā zhǎn kāi dì tú , zhǐ le zhǐ běi biān de xiǎo lù .
lines.en: She spread out the map and pointed at a small road to the north.

lines.zh: 他们在河上建了一座桥。
lines.py: tā men zài hé shàng jiàn le yī zuò qiáo .
lines.en: They built a bridge over the river.

lines.zh: 新图书馆建成以后，我几乎每天都去。
lines.py: xīn tú shū guǎn jiàn chéng yǐ hòu , wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu qù .
lines.en: After the new library was completed, I went almost every day.

lines.zh: 我们在第一次活动后建立了一个群。
lines.py: wǒ men zài dì yī cì huó dòng hòu jiàn lì le yī gè qún .
lines.en: We set up a group chat after the first event.

lines.zh: 附近正在建设新的地铁站。
lines.py: fù jìn zhèng zài jiàn shè xīn de dì tiě zhàn .
lines.en: A new underground station is being built nearby.

lines.zh: 这个读书小组成立三年了。
lines.py: zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ chéng lì sān nián le .
lines.en: This reading group was founded three years ago.

lines.zh: 图书馆设立了儿童阅读区。
lines.py: tú shū guǎn shè lì le ér tóng yuè dú qū .
lines.en: The library set up a reading area for children.

lines.zh: 那家厂现在不生产汽车了。
lines.py: nà jiā chǎng xiàn zài bù shēng chǎn qì chē le .
lines.en: That factory no longer makes cars.

lines.zh: 她毕业后和朋友一起创业。
lines.py: tā bì yè hòu hé péng you yì qǐ chuàng yè .
lines.en: After graduating she started a business with a friend.

lines.zh: 我姐姐从事翻译工作。
lines.py: wǒ jiě jie cóng shì fān yì gōng zuò .
lines.en: My sister works as a translator.

lines.zh: 他们一家经营这家店十多年了。
lines.py: tā men yī jiā jīng yíng zhè jiā diàn shí duō nián le .
lines.en: Their family has run this shop for over ten years.

lines.zh: 周末生意很好，老板忙得没时间吃饭。
lines.py: zhōu mò shēng yì hěn hǎo , lǎo bǎn máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn .
lines.en: Business is good at weekends; the owner is too busy to eat.

lines.zh: 她用第一份工资给妈妈买了礼物。
lines.py: tā yòng dì yī fèn gōng zī gěi mā mā mǎi le lǐ wù .
lines.en: She bought her mum a gift with her first pay.

lines.zh: 所有职工都可以参加周五的活动。
lines.py: suǒ yǒu zhí gōng dōu kě yǐ cān jiā zhōu wǔ de huó dòng .
lines.en: All employees can join the Friday event.

lines.zh: 学校周六有就业介绍会。
lines.py: xué xiào zhōu liù yǒu jiù yè jiè shào huì .
lines.en: The school has a careers event on Saturday.

lines.zh: 她把大部分时间都用在自己的事业上。
lines.py: tā bǎ dà bù fèn shí jiān dōu yòng zài zì jǐ de shì yè shàng .
lines.en: She spends most of her time on her career.

lines.zh: 这家公司需要会两种语言的人才。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī xū yào huì liǎng zhǒng yǔ yán de rén cái .
lines.en: This company needs talented people who speak two languages.

lines.zh: 朋友的鼓励推动我完成了这个计划。
lines.py: péng you de gǔ lì tuī dòng wǒ wán chéng le zhè gè jì huà .
lines.en: My friend's encouragement helped me complete the plan.

lines.zh: 我们先解决最急的问题，再推进其他工作。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān jiě jué zuì jí de wèn tí , zài tuī jìn qí tā gōng zuò .
lines.en: We'll solve the most urgent problem first, then move the other work forward.

lines.zh: 新体育馆已经建成，下个月就能用了。
lines.py: xīn tǐ yù guǎn yǐ jīng jiàn chéng , xià gè yuè jiù néng yòng le .
lines.en: The new sports hall is complete and will be usable next month.

lines.zh: 这条路还在建设，公交车得绕一下。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù hái zài jiàn shè , gōng jiāo chē děi rào yī xià .
lines.en: This road is still under construction, so buses have to take a detour.

lines.zh: 我们三年前成立了这个乐队。
lines.py: wǒ men sān nián qián chéng lì le zhè gè yuè duì .
lines.en: We formed this band three years ago.

lines.zh: 医院在门口设立了临时咨询点。
lines.py: yī yuàn zài mén kǒu shè lì le lín shí zī xún diǎn .
lines.en: The hospital set up a temporary information point at the entrance.

lines.zh: 这家厂以前生产自行车。
lines.py: zhè jiā chǎng yǐ qián shēng chǎn zì xíng chē .
lines.en: This factory used to make bicycles.

lines.zh: 毕业前，老师给我们介绍了几种就业机会。
lines.py: bì yè qián , lǎo shī gěi wǒ men jiè shào le jǐ zhǒng jiù yè jī huì .
lines.en: Before graduation, our teacher told us about several job opportunities.

lines.zh: 我们公司正在找设计方面的人才。
lines.py: wǒ men gōng sī zhèng zài zhǎo shè jì fāng miàn de rén cái .
lines.en: Our company is looking for talented designers.

lines.zh: 这次合作推动了两个小组的交流。
lines.py: zhè cì hé zuò tuī dòng le liǎng gè xiǎo zǔ de jiāo liú .
lines.en: This collaboration encouraged exchange between the two groups.

lines.zh: 材料到了，我们终于能推进下一步工作了。
lines.py: cái liào dào le , wǒ men zhōng yú néng tuī jìn xià yī bù gōng zuò le .
lines.en: The materials have arrived, so we can finally move the next stage forward.

audio.zh: 有。我想开一家小书店，周末开展读书活动。
audio.py: yǒu . wǒ xiǎng kāi yī jiā xiǎo shū diàn , zhōu mò kāi zhǎn dú shū huó dòng .
audio.en: Yes. I'd like to open a small bookshop and hold reading events at weekends.

tasks.statement: The speaker wants to open a car factory.
tasks.why: The speaker describes a bookshop, not a factory.

audio.zh: 去年，我和朋友在学校附近开了一家书店。我们都没有经营经验，最初只想到书和咖啡。
audio.py: qù nián , wǒ hé péng you zài xué xiào fù jìn kāi le yī jiā shū diàn . wǒ men dōu méi yǒu jīng yíng jīng yàn , zuì chū zhǐ xiǎng dào shū hé kā fēi .
audio.en: Last year a friend and I opened a bookshop near the school. Neither of us had experience running a business; initially we only thought about books and coffee.

tasks.statement: Two friends opened a bookshop last year.

prompt.py: nǐ wèi shén me yě xiǎng mài kā fēi ?
prompt.en: Why do you also want to sell coffee?

choices: 这样大家可以坐下来聊天。
tasks.answer: 这样大家可以坐下来聊天。
tasks.why: Coffee and seating support the social purpose.

prompt.py: nǐ xiǎng xiān mǎi shū ma ?
prompt.en: Do you want to buy books first?

tasks.why: Finding the premises comes first in this plan.

natural.py: yào bù wǒ péi nǐ qù kàn kàn ?
natural.en: Shall I come and have a look with you?

pragmatics.note: 要不 offers a tentative suggestion, leaving room to decline.

natural.zh: 我有几个问题想请教你。
natural.py: wǒ yǒu jǐ gè wèn tí xiǎng qǐng jiào nǐ .
natural.en: I'd like to ask you about a few things.

pragmatics.note: 请教 recognizes the listener’s experience; it need not sound formal or grand.

conversation.context: A small business, a real plan
conversation.goal: Explain the order of a shared plan

turns.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng xiān zuò shén me ?
turns.meaning: What do you want to do first?
examples: 我想先找一个合适的地方。

turns.meaning: Have you put aside money for books?
examples: 还没有。我先找地方，其次才是买书。

examples: 好啊，我想听听她的意见。
